children.name: Burkholderia mallei
children.description: Burkholderia mallei is a Gram-negative, bipolar or variable Gram staining, , aerobic bacterium, a human and animal pathogen of genus Burkholderia causing glanders; the Latin name of this disease (malleus) gave its name to the species causing it.
